curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When a traitorous lord strikes without warning, can the legendary King of Rohan hold the fortress against an assault fueled by blood vengeance?
curatedMovie.description: Seeking revenge for his father's death, the cunning lord Wulf launches a sudden assault on Rohan, forcing King Helm Hammerhand and his people into a desperate last stand within the ancient stronghold of the Hornburg.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced and emotionally charged, delivering engaged siege suspense and grand fantasy spectacle.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This animated fantasy adventure pairs a sudden attack with a last-stand setup for viewers seeking large-scale action.

facts.title: The Lord of the Rings: The War of the Rohirrim
